( AI-generated image for representational purposes only ) AI Quick Read Gold, silver prices today, 15 November: Spot gold prices slumped by 4.5% this week — the most since June, while silver, platinum and palladium also looked on the way toward weekly declines, according to a Reuters report. Gold prices have taken a hit during the week amid concern from investors that the United States Federal Reserve (Fed) seems poised to hike interest rates and higher oil prices could push inflation, Bloomberg reported. Spot gold moved up 0.1% at $3,879.71 per ounce as of 1905 GMT, after briefly touching a session high of $3,922.97 when the US Producer Price Index ( PPI ) data came out, the Reuters report stated. US gold futures for December delivery settled largely unchanged at $3,886.30/oz, it added. Further, spot silver fell 1.9% to $49.05/oz, platinum fell 1.9% to $1,490.06, while palladium climbed 1.1% to $1,004.40, the report said, noting that all three metals were also on course to post losses for the week.
